package.description: Book studio sessions, sync your Studio Drive, and share your work from your own studio page.

en-US.description: Book studio sessions, sync your Studio Drive, and share your work from your own studio page.
en-US.longDescription:
Studio World is a workspace for people who make things in studios. Book and
manage sessions, keep a Studio Drive that syncs your project folder and its
checkpoints across your machines and your collaborators, and publish a studio
page that shows what you have been working on.

The Windows app is the same Studio World as the mobile and web apps and signs
in with the same account, so a drive set up on one machine follows you to the
next.
en-US.name: Studio World
